title: Six Degrees of Legend: John Legend

types.inspo: Inspiration on record: named muses, Desert Island Discs, samples
types.signed: Signings, mentoring, the call that started Muse

nodes.name: John Legend
nodes.blurb: Born John Roger Stephens in Springfield, Ohio, 1978. Piano at four, church choir at seven, Penn at sixteen, and a church gig in Scranton every weekend. Muse is produced in full by Pharrell.

nodes.name: Pharrell Williams
nodes.blurb: Virginia Beach. One half of The Neptunes with Chad Hugo. Louis Vuitton men's creative director since 2023, which is why Muse was made in a studio inside the Paris headquarters.

nodes.name: Clipse
nodes.blurb: Brothers from Virginia Beach. First act signed to Pharrell's Star Trak. Their 2025 comeback opened with John on the hook, and they return the favor on Bodies On The Floor.

nodes.name: Voices of Fire
nodes.blurb: The gospel choir Pharrell and his uncle Bishop Ezekiel Williams went looking for in Hampton Roads, Virginia, filmed for a 2020 series. On The Birds Don't Sing in 2025 and Fireflies on Muse.

nodes.name: Samm Henshaw
nodes.blurb: South London singer raised by Nigerian parents. Wrote Daylight with Pharrell, the song that started the album, and has writing credits on six Muse songs.

nodes.name: Wayne Hector
nodes.blurb: British hitmaker behind seven Westlife number ones. A writer on Daylight.

nodes.name: Kawan "KP" Prather
nodes.blurb: Atlanta. Dungeon Family DJ, LaFace A&R for Usher and OutKast, A&R on John's Evolver in 2008. Eighteen years later, a co-writer on five Muse songs and a background voice on a sixth.

nodes.name: Usher
nodes.blurb: Background vocals on Pray For Ya. In 2019 he was battle advisor on John's team on The Voice.

nodes.name: Terrace Martin
nodes.blurb: Producer and saxophonist, deep in the making of Kendrick Lamar's To Pimp a Butterfly. Horns and arrangements across Muse. Born December 28, 1978, the same day as John.

nodes.name: Larry Gold
nodes.blurb: Conducts and arranges the strings on eleven Muse songs.

nodes.name: Matt Jones
nodes.blurb: Wrote and conducted the two orchestral introductions, Her Introduction and Under The Bridge Introduction, with the Matt Jones Orchestra.

nodes.name: Steven Tirpak

edges.title: Hugo's house
edges.story: Malice met Chad Hugo in 1988; Pusha T started rapping at Hugo's house.

edges.title: Virginia Beach
edges.story: As a teenage rapper, Malice met Chad Hugo in 1988 and Pharrell in 1990. Pusha T was rapping at Hugo's house one day, and Pharrell convinced the brothers to form a duo.

edges.title: Band camp
edges.story: Pharrell (drums) and Chad Hugo (tenor sax) met at a seventh grade summer band camp; they formed The Neptunes in Virginia Beach in 1992.

edges.title: LaFace Records

edges.title: Soulquarians

edges.title: The audition in Jersey
edges.quote: I get on the piano just to show her what I could do.
edges.story: A Penn student playing a church in Scranton every weekend, John was taken to Jersey by choir member Tara Michel, who went to high school with Lauryn. He sang Stevie Wonder and an original.

edges.title: Everything Is Everything
edges.quote: That was my first credit on any album. And it was one of the greatest albums of all time.
edges.story: Piano on Track 13 of The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill. His first album credit, as John R. Stephens. At Penn his nickname became Track 13.

edges.title: The audition song
edges.quote: I sang a little Stevie Wonder, sang an original song, too.
edges.story: At the Lauryn Hill audition, John sang a little Stevie Wonder.

edges.title: Scranton choir

highlights.title: From A&R to co-writer
highlights.text: Kawan Prather was the A&R on Evolver in 2008. On Muse he co-writes five songs (Pray For Ya, Her, Get Back, Are You Ok? and Under The Bridge) and sings background vocals on a sixth, Daylight.

highlights.title: Team Legend, then the choir stand
highlights.text: Usher advised John's team on The Voice in 2019. Seven years later he sings background on Pray For Ya.

highlights.title: The part he never got credit for
highlights.text: John sang uncredited backing vocals on You Don't Know My Name in 2003. On their 2020 Verzuz he sang it again, at the piano.

highlights.title: The audition song
highlights.text: At 19 John auditioned for Lauryn Hill singing Stevie Wonder. Stevie later played harmonica on his Christmas album and is among the muses in his head for Muse.

highlights.title: Pharrell's hometown choir
highlights.text: Voices of Fire, found in Hampton Roads, Virginia, sing on The Birds Don't Sing, the hook that started Muse, and again on Fireflies.
